fixture.drag_motion: alternating endpoint scrub through a held native numeric slider
fixture.reference: independent analytic Linear/Tone; spatial in-gamut swatches
fixture.observer_off: external capture disabled; Image Editor draw cadence retained; acceptance snapshots disabled

limitations: Capture completion is an observed upper bound including X11 readback, not physical scanout time.
Acceptance timestamps mark entry to the actual Grade property callback, after native event delivery.
The fixed Linux fixture uses Mesa llvmpipe rather than a hardware GPU.
Calibration and independent reference calculations occur outside measured input intervals.
The Viewer image is shown in Blender's Image Editor beside the production Compositor sidebar.
